subject.title: feat(gateway): watched sessions in presence with viewer facepiles

question: Should watched-session metadata be restricted to session-read-authorized recipients, or is broad exposure to pairing/node presence consumers an intentional gateway privacy-contract change?
rationale: The intended visibility of session identifiers is a security and product-boundary decision; an automated repair should not broaden or redefine presence authorization on its own.

options.title: Restrict watched-session projection
options.body: Expose watched sessions only through a recipient-scoped projection that preserves existing session-read authorization, with focused authorization and live behavior proof.

options.title: Accept broader presence visibility
options.body: Treat watched-session keys as general presence metadata and explicitly document and approve the resulting disclosure to pairing/node clients.

recommendation.title: Restrict watched-session projection
recommendation.body: Expose watched sessions only through a recipient-scoped projection that preserves existing session-read authorization, with focused authorization and live behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the related shared-gateway identity workstream and authored the merged presence foundation.
